text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 101,258 to 95,091 despite brief rebounds; I should judge progress over a suitable horizon, not let one month's move dictate a trade.","Doing nothing avoided impulsive reactions, but repeated inaction is not a plan: I should review holdings and risk each period and act when my investment case or limits warrant it.","Because past price moves do not predict future ones, I should base buys and sells on a consistent process rather than trying to time a recovery."]}
